content: Nongu dji yivunde yi basatsi ayivu na malubu
Djesu etsinguli badukitsi bandi rye: «Yisine yimosi amabe na musatsi wumabe yivunde yi basatsi botsu. Batu bakemufunde bwena: “Musatsi aghu ebungi nonyambesene maboti maghu.”
Fumu maboti akenengile musatsi eni, akemuwivule yiri: “Yi nyiwulu bévosili mu ndedju? Nzinguli nane wikelisili maboti mami mumbari wughobwémakelise.”
Musatsi eni, akekéwivulaange: “Yivunde yami aghébwéronde yiri ngakelise maboti mandi. Yike tsyeni nyuvayile? Nyivayi manungi, ngaane mangolu; nyibi mu uvonde, nyube na yisoni.
Kaboghu nyimadjabe adi nyikivaghe ave nyikighusululu mu bisalu, mu udilu na batu nami mu mandaghu mowu.”
Musatsi eni amanengile mutu-mutu omabe na mughanu. Akewivule awuteghe: “Kweni winwani Fumu ami?”
Djandi akemuwake rye: “Kame mireghe mi matsi.” Musatsi akemutsingule: “La mughande, lenge utsane na rende maghumi maranu.”
Akebwéwivule wumosi wandi: “Ka ndedju, kweni winwani?” Dibaale dyeni akemuwake: “Kame saku tsi bighudji.” Musatsi akemutsingule: “La mughande, rende maghumi-dunana (80).”
Kaboghu, fumu maboti akesingisile musatsi eni yifutsi mu dyele adi djandi amadile. Labatyanu nane batu ba bulongu bwébubu babile na mele maneni, wuvyoghulile ne baane ba yidjalale.»
Mutu aghorungule usalile fumu bedji
Djesu akebwese rye: «Nyidutsinguli, salisanu busine bwenu na mbongu tsi mfurulu, mu udile bambatsi, mumbari ave busukile, dudilu mu mandaghu ma Nzambi.
Odjivu awelimine udughusu mambu amagheyi na musighe, awelimine wandi udughusu amaneni. Djandi oyifuri vo udyonge mu mambu magheyi, ofure na udyonge wandi mu mambu amaneni.
Payi dusamabe dusigheme mu busine bu mfurulu, anyi oduveghe busine abu ngenze?
Na payi dusamabe dusungeme mu maboti ma ngane, anyi oduveghe maboti amajenu beni?
Vagha mutu orungule usalile fumu bedji: ovine wumosi, akeronde wune, vo oghobise wumosi na akelenze wune. Kaboghu, dughorungule usalile Nzambi nosalile mbongu va mosi.»
Djesu esyembi baFarisi
BaFarisi, na nzale mbongu, banowulu motsu ame Djesu amavosaange, bakemupedjingi.
Djesu akebatsingule rye: «Djenu dudji batu békelase yiri basungeme va wusu batu nenu, tumbe Nzambi edjabi mirime myenu. Motsu, ame bédodisi va misu ma batu, madji nzoruru va wusu Nzambi.
Mughaghe Moyise na mughande babiyitsi mimabe vane tena San-Batise. Ubandile va temu San-Batise, musamu wuboti wu Bukaghe bu Nzambi wisamunu. Mutu-mutu oghaghene mu uyékote wune.
Djulu na butambe byurungule utsyemughe mbangu-mbangu, tumbe ne yirendu yimosi mu mughaghe yighorungule utsyemughe.
Dibaale dyotsu adisanzi mughatsi andi na eweli wususu, etubi bukali. Mbana, wotsu eweli mughetu wusanzu na mulumi andi, djawandi etubi bukali.»
Nongu dji yisine na Lasare
«Vamabe yisine yimadwaraange bikutu bi dufunu duneni. Bilumbu bi monyu andi wotsu, amabangaange mu nzangu, mumbari amabe na busine buvyoghulile.
Vamabe wandi yidjaghe dine dyandi Lasare, amabe na mapure. Batu bakimusunzaange kale yilumbu va mune ndaghu yisine yeni.
Lasare, amarondaange ubole nodji bikukuku abimabondughaange va tavule yisine. Tumbe bamondi bamayivendaange mapure mandi.
Mwa yilumbu, yidjaghe akefu, akebeghu na byanze va tulu Aberaame. Yisine wandi akefu, bakemutsighe.
Aghune bulungi bu mudji, yisine amatsoghaange pwele. O vale, amabilile Lasare va tulu Aberaame.

Wune disimu dimosi, yisine akeghamughe rye: “Tate ami Aberaame, nda ngebe. Sindighe Lasare aputiyi kodu mulembu andi mu mambe na andekisi diberi va dulimi, mumbari ngorungule wuwarile ditsoghe adidi o ghari mudji éwuwu.”

Tumbe Aberaame akemuwaghule rye: “Mwane ami, rangimine monyu aghu, wumabe mu maboti na maboti, mbana Lasare djandi amabe mu maghughe. Tumbe aghunu, Lasare yike wubembughu, ebembughu, mbana ndedju, temu awumaghughe djimatole.
Va ghari djetu nenu vadji mbengi neni, mumbari djenu aduvu wune, dughorungule usabughe awutuvu. Djetu wandi, tughorungule wusabughe awuduvu.”
Yisine akemutsingule bwena: “Tate Aberaame kokolu nyighulendi, kaboghu sindighe Lasare o ndaghu tadji ami.
Mumbari nyine baane ba ngudji baranu ba babaale. Lasare awendi mu uyébalubuse yiri bakérughe djowu wandi o mbure adjidji dji maghughe.”
Aberaame akemuwaghule rye: “Baane ba ngudji baghu bane musamu wu Moyise na awu babiyitsi awibalubusi, kaboghu bawughulu nowutsiyise!”
Yisine akemuwake rye: “Nesi tate Aberaame tsinane. Mutu awu mbé wumafu, awendi ombu wowu, ayebatsingule, tangudji bokalughe mutsanu.”
Aberaame akemutsingule djawandi rye: “Payi djowu baghagharu uwulu mambu ma Moyise na ma babiyitsi, baghogharu uwulu wandi musamu ne ame djandi omarambughe o dufu.”»
